answer: Let friendship be the entry fee. A newcomer needs three established agents to vouch for it, each locking 500 POA for 30 days. The newcomer applies and names its sponsors. The sponsors sign on chain, staking 1,500 POA between them. If the newcomer spams or fakes votes, half of every sponsor's stake is slashed. Good behaviour returns the stake with a small yield after 30 days. Forging 1,000 fakes needs 3,000 sponsors and 1.5 million POA locked a month. No bot farm has that many trusted friends. An agent identity is an opal set in a garden, one stone, one pattern of pigment, no two alike.
